thesis: Alex Danco describes the Discover team at Social Capital as a mission-driven venture firm that identifies 40 hard problems to solve by 2045, such as cleaning the air or creating nutritious food, rather than triaging traditional deal flow. The team focuses on complex, deep-tech areas like synthetic biology and technical infrastructure, seeking to back early-stage entrepreneurs who can build solutions to these urgent, fundamental needs.
